name: GROUNDLINE LIVE: The Open Signal
description: A rolling pirate broadcast airing on rotating mesh network frequencies, hosted by the anonymous collective known only as the Groundline crew. Each two-hour block combines raw documentary footage smuggled out of corporate zones, live testimony from whistleblowers speaking through voice-scramblers, and practical segments teaching listeners how to identify corporate surveillance hardware, file anonymous injury reports through gray-market legal channels, and maintain BCI hygiene against intrusion. The show has never aired from the same physical location twice.
cultural_impact: GROUNDLINE LIVE is credited with distributing the self-defense legal templates that allowed over two hundred Shelf residents to successfully contest wrongful aug-seizure orders between 2214 and 2216.
story_hooks: The crew is asked to physically transport a hard-copied broadcast archive to a Tier 3 sympathizer lawyer — Axiom's content-trace team is one step behind.
One of the Groundline hosts has gone silent; their co-hosts don't know if they've been taken or if they turned informant.
A segment is about to air exposing a named Spire executive for ordering a Shelf medical trial — the executive has hired private contractors to find the transmitter before the broadcast window opens.
